name: Galileo Galilei
summary: Italian astronomer, physicist and engineer who pioneered the experimental method and confirmed heliocentric theory.

name: Giulia Ammannati
summary: Mother of Galileo Galilei.

name: Vincenzo Galilei
summary: Musician and father of Galileo Galilei.

name: Ostilio Ricci
summary: Mathematician who taught Galileo in Florence.

name: Fabricius ab Acquapendente
summary: Anatomist and surgeon at the University of Padua.

name: Cosimo II de' Medici
summary: Grand Duke of Tuscany and patron of Galileo.

name: Leonardo Donato
summary: Doge of Venice who supported Galileo's appointment at Padua.

name: Giovanni Francesco Sagredo
summary: Friend of Galileo who corresponded with him.

name: Christopher Clavius
summary: Jesuit of the Roman College who welcomed Galileo.

name: Federico Cesi
summary: Founder of the Lincei Academy.

name: Tommaso Caccini
summary: Dominican friar who accused Galileo of heresy.

name: Roberto Bellarmino
summary: Cardinal and Jesuit who led the Holy Office and warned Galileo.

name: Maffeo Barberini
summary: Pope who initially admired Galileo but later condemned him.

name: Virginia Galilei
summary: Daughter of Galileo who lived in a cloister near Arcetri.

name: Vincenzo Viviani
summary: Pupil of Galileo who assisted him when blind.

name: Evangelista Torricelli
summary: Pupil of Galileo who assisted him when blind.

name: University of Pisa
summary: Italian university where Galileo studied and later taught.

name: University of Padua
summary: Italian university where Galileo taught for 18 years.

name: Serenissima Republic of Venice
summary: State that employed Galileo at Padua.

name: Lincei Academy
summary: Scientific academy founded by Federico Cesi.

name: Holy Office
summary: Church institution that tried and condemned Galileo.

name: Pisa
summary: City in Italy where Galileo was born.

name: Florence
summary: City in Italy where Galileo met Ricci and later lived.

name: Padua
summary: City in Italy where Galileo taught for 18 years.

name: Venice
summary: City where Galileo presented the telescope.

name: Rome
summary: City where Galileo was tried.

name: Arcetri
summary: Place near Florence where Galileo was confined.

name: Telescope
summary: Optical instrument invented by Galileo with 18-20 fold magnification.

name: Compass
summary: Instrument invented by Galileo in Padua.

name: Sidereus Nuncius
summary: Book published by Galileo in 1610 proving his observations.

name: Dialogue concerning the Two Chief World System
summary: Book published by Galileo in 1632 reporting his theses.

name: Discourses and Mathematical Demonstrations Relating Two New Sciences
summary: Book published by Galileo in 1638 confirming his views.

name: Santa Croce Church
summary: Church in Florence where Galileo was buried.

name: Santa Maria Minerva
summary: Church in Rome where Galileo was tried.
